# xkbcommon

Just contains the `xkbcommon-keysyms.h` header, which is installed to `$PREFIX/include/aqua/xkbcommon-keysyms.h`.
It is installed by the C library (`lib/`).

You can update this by regenerating it in <https://github.com/xkbcommon/libxkbcommon>, but it should be fairly stable either way.
